remarks: Welcome home to this wonderful 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath unit located in the heart of Harbor Point. The unit has been freshly painted, cleaned and has many updates. Light-filled, updated kitchen features ample cabinet space, stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Also features a large pantry or storage/coat closet. Step into the large combo dining/living area with newer light fixtures. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Convenient half-bath on main level. The second floor features a sunny and large primary bedroom with generous closet space. Secondary bedroom also has ample closet space. Full bath in hallway. In unit Washer/Dryer. This unit comes with two assigned parking spaces, and a storage cage in the shared basement. This location is convenient to the vibrant Harbor Point area, shops, restaurants, moments to the train station & 95, as well as downtown Stamford. Space, Convenience & a vibrant location!
